source: MotionSites public tutorials and indexed examples

patterns.name: Poster → Video → Canvas Crossfade
patterns.summary: Progressively upgrade the same visual from poster to video to canvas while crossfading between media layers.

patterns.name: Frame-Cache Scrubber
patterns.summary: Decode a bounded frame cache from video and draw frame bitmaps by scroll progress for smoother deterministic scrubbing.

patterns.name: Scroll Lerp Controller
patterns.summary: Interpolate current motion progress toward target scroll progress inside requestAnimationFrame instead of applying raw scroll directly.

patterns.name: Canvas Object-Cover Render
patterns.summary: Draw media to canvas using object-cover math so framing stays consistent across responsive viewports.

patterns.name: Intersection Stagger Reveal
patterns.summary: Reveal text and controls with staggered fade-up motion only when each block enters the viewport.

patterns.name: Scroll Spacer Timeline
patterns.summary: Use deliberate spacer height between narrative sections to give a scrubbed background enough scroll distance to complete a visual transformation.

patterns.name: Frosted Capability Panel
patterns.summary: Place concise feature rows inside a translucent panel over moving media while keeping hierarchy and legibility intact.

patterns.name: Chevron Hover Nudge
patterns.summary: Use a tiny directional icon translation as a restrained affordance rather than animating the entire card.

patterns.name: Mobile Cinematic Stack
patterns.summary: Reflow split desktop hero compositions into a vertical stack while keeping the motion focal point unobstructed.

patterns.name: Media-Safe Empty Zone
patterns.summary: Reserve a viewport zone with no text or controls so the most important part of the moving media remains visible during scroll.

patterns.name: Small Refinement Loop
patterns.summary: After the core motion works, change spacing, typography, opacity and navigation in isolated passes instead of redesigning the entire page.

patterns.name: Sticky Media + Negative-Margin Content Shell
patterns.summary: Keep a sticky full-screen media stage behind a higher z-index content wrapper that visually overlaps the media without duplicating layout height.
